win32.claude-code: claude mcp add --scope user -e PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 -e PYTHONUTF8=1 --transport stdio uoink -- <PYTHON> <MCP> '--isolated-profile' <PROFILE> '--isolated-port' '5187'
win32.kilo-legacy:
Use uoink connect kilo for current Kilo. The old .kilocode/mcp.json
recipe is unverified and is no longer printed. Check the docs for your older
extension version before migrating its settings.
win32.ollama:
Ollama is a model runtime, not an MCP client. Use Open WebUI or Continue
as the MCP client with an Ollama model that supports tools:
  uoink connect open-webui
  uoink connect continue
Configure the model provider separately in that client. No Ollama mcp.json is needed.
win32.windows-odr:
On a supported Windows build, register a valid unpacked local MCPB bundle:
odr.exe mcp add "C:\path with spaces\uoink-bundle\manifest.json"
odr.exe list
The manifest path is positional, not --uri. Keep its relative bundle files
beside it. A repository manifest alone is not an installed bundle.
Uoink's installer never runs ODR.
win32.obsidian:
Windows: choose the vault root, choose all items or an item-ID allowlist,
Preview, then Enable. Uoink writes evidence cards, shelves and accepted briefs
under <vault>/Uoink/. This is an opt-in one-way Markdown export, not full-media
or two-way sync. Open its index with (replace and URL-encode your vault name):
obsidian://open?vault=Research%20Vault&file=Uoink%2FLibrary
macOS: Library Mirror is gated off. Use uoink search, recent and get, or a
local MCP client, to read the library. Copy selected results into notes manually.
No Obsidian MCP plugin or automatic Mac mirror is claimed.
win32.n8n:
Run self-hosted n8n on the same host as Uoink. Containers have their own localhost.
HTTP Request node: GET http://127.0.0.1:5179/memory/search
Query parameters: q=working memory, limit=5. Authentication: Generic Credential
Type > Header Auth. Store X-Uoink-Token and its value in n8n credentials.
MCP Client Tool (connected to an AI Agent): select HTTP Streamable and endpoint
http://127.0.0.1:5179/mcp/v1. Select Header Auth credentials for X-Uoink-Token.
Choose only the tools the workflow needs. No stdio route is documented for this node.
Use the configured port if different. Client acceptance is not yet tested.
Never put the token in a URL, workflow export, chat, or log. Cloud runners cannot
reach this PC's 127.0.0.1. See docs/connect-your-agent.md for both node recipes.
win32.make:
Make cloud runners cannot reach this PC's 127.0.0.1. Make documents a
separate Enterprise on-prem agent; no Uoink recipe for it has been tested.
Use uoink connect n8n for same-host self-hosted automation.
win32.zapier:
Zapier's cloud HTTP actions cannot reach this PC's 127.0.0.1.
Use uoink connect n8n for same-host self-hosted automation.
No public endpoint or tunnel is configured by Uoink.
win32.powertoys:
In Command Palette, use Run commands (>), then enter:
"<CLI>" search "working memory" --text
This launches the CLI; it does not provide inline library search results.
win32.crush: mcp add uoink --command <PYTHON> --args <MCP> --isolated-profile <PROFILE> --isolated-port 5187 --env PYTHONIOENCODING utf-8 --env PYTHONUTF8 1

darwin.perplexity:
Install the PerplexityXPC helper from the Mac app's local MCP setup.
Add a custom local connector; in the Simple tab enter name uoink and command:
/usr/bin/env PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONUTF8=1 <PYTHON> -B -s <MCP> --isolated-profile <PROFILE> --isolated-port 5187
Save, wait for Running, then enable it under Sources. Local MCP is Mac-only;
remote connectors in the web app cannot launch this command.
